senses.gloss: m. (בקלס, בקל with ס intens., as בלעס a. בלע; cmp. Syr. בוקלא P. Sm. 474; √בק, cmp. בקעת) club, shepherd’s crook.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:14">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>קם נסב בקלסיה</he> (or <cite ref="B01127"><he>בקלסא</he></cite>) he stood up, took (his) crook and broke the idols, <he>ויהב בוקלסא וכ׳</he> and placed the crook into the hand of the largest of them (Rashi <he>בולקסא</he>, corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>בַּקְלָסֵי</he>, (<cite ref="B01114"><he>בַּקּוֹלְסֵי</he></cite>) <cite ref="B01127"><he>בּוּקְלָסֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Zevachim 105a:6">Zeb. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>נקיטי לה בבו׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>בבקולסי</he>; Ms. M. <he>בקלסי</he>, Ar. s. v. <cite ref="S01377"><he>קלס</he></cite>, <he>בקולסי</he>, Ms. R. 1 <he>בקינסי</he>, Ms. K. <he>בקונסי</he>) they seize it (the sacrifice to be burnt) with crooks (while standing outside).
